section_summary: This section covers State Department and military correspondence from late 1946 to late 1947 regarding entry permits, military clearance, and travel regulations for occupied Japan. It documents commercial and personal entry inquiries from foreign nationals and American businesses, policy telegrams regarding the admission of missionaries, and internal procedures for routing permit applications between State and the Army. Included are multiple copies and drafts of SCAP Circular No. 8 of August 30, 1946, establishing comprehensive rules for entry and exit of individuals, aircraft, and vessels.

subfiles.about: Thorkil Host applies for a military permit to visit Japan to re-establish commercial contacts for the Maersk Line.
subfiles.summary: Host requests permission to visit shipping agents in Kobe, Nagoya, Shimizu, Yokohama, and Tokyo to prepare for postwar commercial shipping.
subfiles.title: Application of Thorkil Host for Permit to Visit Japan

subfiles.about: Thorkil Host asks Jesse E. Saugstad to expedite State Department permission to depart the United States.
subfiles.summary: Host requests urgent action on his departure permit so he can obtain an immigration re-entry permit before leaving.
subfiles.title: Letter from Thorkil Host Requesting Expedited Departure Permit

subfiles.about: Shipping Division requests the Visa Division urgently expedite Thorkil Host's departure permit.
subfiles.summary: Saugstad forwards correspondence and urges the Visa Division to expedite Host's departure permit before December 1.
subfiles.title: Memorandum Regarding Departure Permit for Thorkil Host

subfiles.about: Thorkil Host submits his application for permission to depart the United States on business for Moller Steamship Company.
subfiles.summary: Host encloses his departure application and INS documentation for his upcoming Far East business journey.
subfiles.title: Letter Transmitting Departure Application of Thorkil Host

subfiles.about: Discusses procedural obstacles faced by Swiss citizens attempting to secure military clearance and transit visas for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Swiss Attaché Jolles notes US consuls in Switzerland require official US clearance before granting transit visas to Japan.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on Clearance for Swiss Citizens

subfiles.about: H. Slettengren inquires whether Swedish commercial representatives can obtain visas to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Inquires whether Swedish businessmen can obtain entry visas for Japan and requests necessary application forms.
subfiles.title: Letter Inquiring on Visas for Swedish Businessmen

subfiles.about: The Secretary of State instructs the consulate in Göteborg regarding entry rules and business travel restrictions for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Directs consular officer to inform Slettengren that entry requests must go through Tokyo and commercial travel is not permitted.
subfiles.title: Instruction to American Consular Officer in Göteborg Regarding Entry into Japan
subfiles.to: American Consular Officer in Charge, Göteborg

subfiles.about: Internal note recommending delaying reply to H. Slettengren until Sweden appoints a representative in Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Recommends holding reply to Slettengren until Lars Tillitse arrives in Tokyo and circular instructions are distributed.
subfiles.title: Note on Postponing Reply to Swedish Inquiry

subfiles.about: Records negative findings in State Department files regarding Swedish inquirer H. Slettengren.
subfiles.summary: Wolberg records that inter-divisional checks revealed no information concerning H. Slettengren.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files Concerning H. Slettengren

subfiles.about: War Department asks whether SCAP's missionary entry policy applies to Korea, outlying islands, and non-Christian faiths.
subfiles.summary: Asks SCAP whether missionary entry policy applies to Korea and outlying islands, and if non-Christian missionaries are included.
subfiles.title: Telegram Inquiring on Missionary Policy for Outlying Islands and Non-Christians
subfiles.to: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, Tokyo

subfiles.about: SCAP clarifies that missionary entry policy excludes Korea, but outlying islands and non-Christian faiths are considered individually.
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Clarifies that missionary policy does not apply to Korea, while outlying island and non-Christian requests are reviewed individually.
subfiles.title: Telegram on Missionary Entry Policy for Korea and Outlying Islands

subfiles.about: Transmits Joint Chiefs of Staff memo and enclosure regarding missionary Father Venard van Bastelaer.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Joint Chiefs memorandum concerning Father Venard van Bastelaer for appropriate action.
subfiles.title: Routing Slip Regarding Father Venard van Bastelaer

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting incoming despatch from James S. Moose, Jr. concerning Victor Chouah Moche.
subfiles.summary: Records incoming Baghdad despatch regarding Victor Chouah Moche.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch from James S. Moose, Jr.

subfiles.about: US Embassy in Baghdad requests procedural advice concerning entry permit application of Iraqi merchant Victor Chouah Moche.
subfiles.summary: Moose transmits Moche's request to return to Kobe with his fiancée, enclosing Army orders from Kobe Base.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1543 Regarding Japan Entry Permit for Victor Chouah Moche

subfiles.about: Records negative file searches regarding Victor Chouah Moche, Fadhila Shaoul Bassa, and firm H. E. Sassoon.
subfiles.summary: Documents negative divisional file checks concerning Moche, his fiancée, and the firm H. E. Sassoon.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files Regarding Victor Chouah Moche

subfiles.about: Max Factor & Co. requests entry permit for Far East Supervisor Thomas West to survey opening a branch in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Inquires when Shanghai-based supervisor Thomas West can obtain a permit to survey business opportunities in Japan.
subfiles.title: Letter Inquiring on Entry Permit for Thomas West

subfiles.about: State Department explains that overcrowded and unsettled conditions preclude private commercial travel to Japan at present.
subfiles.summary: Whitman states commercial travel is not yet allowed due to difficult conditions, but public announcement will precede reopening.
subfiles.title: Letter Regarding Commercial Travel Restrictions in Japan

subfiles.about: Outlines internal procedure for routing foreign entry applications to Army's Military Permit Section via courier.
subfiles.summary: Details streamlined procedure using Army couriers to deliver foreign entry requests directly to Colonel Lynch.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files on Army Courier Routing Procedure

subfiles.about: S/S-CR approves sending routine Japan entry correspondence directly to Army Military Permit Section via courier.
subfiles.summary: Approves direct courier delivery to Colonel Lynch for routine correspondence, noting completed actions must pass through CR.
subfiles.title: Office Memorandum on Use of Army Courier Service

subfiles.about: Division of Protective Services requests permission to utilize Army courier service for routine Japan entry applications.
subfiles.summary: Proposes using Army courier service for routine correspondence with Colonel Lynch to eliminate multi-day delays.
subfiles.title: Office Memorandum Proposing Use of Army Courier Service

subfiles.about: Transmits SCAP Circular No. 8 and explains entry application procedures for governments lacking Tokyo representation.
subfiles.summary: Transmits SCAP Circular 8 to diplomatic missions, offering State Department facilitation for nations lacking representatives in Japan.
subfiles.title: Circular Note to Chiefs of Mission Transmitting SCAP Circular No. 8

subfiles.about: Comprehensive occupation regulations governing entry and exit of individuals, aircraft, merchant vessels, and warships into Japan.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: SCAP Circular 8 establishes occupation entry and exit procedures for individuals, aircraft, merchant vessels, and warships. Authority is delegated to the Eighth Army, Pacific Air Command, and Naval Activities Japan. Detailed sections define clearance channels, medical immunizations, quarantine requirements, and customs declarations.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 8: Control of Entry and Exit into and from Japan

subfiles.about: Department clearance draft of circular diplomatic note transmitting SCAP Circular No. 8 to foreign missions in Washington.
subfiles.from: Division of Special Projects (E. Williams III)
subfiles.summary: Draft circular note transmitting SCAP Circular 8, containing departmental clearance initials and routing stamps.
subfiles.title: Draft Circular Note to Chiefs of Mission Concerning Travel to Japan

subfiles.about: Official copy of circular note to foreign missions explaining entry application procedures under SCAP Circular 8.
subfiles.summary: Copy of identic note communicating SCAP Circular 8 entry procedures to foreign diplomatic missions in Washington.
subfiles.title: Identic Note to Chiefs of Mission Transmitting SCAP Circular No. 8 (Copy)

subfiles.about: Duplicate official copy of SCAP Circular No. 8 establishing entry and exit regulations for occupied Japan.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Duplicate copy of SCAP Circular 8 setting detailed rules for entry and exit of individuals, aircraft, and naval and merchant vessels. Implementing commands enforce mandatory clearance, strict public health immunizations, and customs inspections.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 8: Control of Entry and Exit (Duplicate Copy)

subfiles.about: Duplicate copy of circular diplomatic note transmitting SCAP Circular No. 8 to Chiefs of Mission in Washington.
subfiles.summary: Additional official copy of identic note transmitting SCAP Circular 8 and explaining entry clearance procedures for unrepresented nations.
subfiles.title: Identic Note to Chiefs of Mission Transmitting SCAP Circular No. 8 (Duplicate Copy)

subfiles.about: Duplicate file copy of SCAP Circular No. 8 governing entry and exit of individuals, aircraft, and surface vessels.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Full duplicate copy of SCAP Circular 8 prescribing entry and exit procedures for individuals, aircraft, merchant shipping, and combatant vessels. It defines the responsibilities of occupation armed services, designated ports of entry in the Tokyo-Yokohama area, and quarantine regulations.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 8: Control of Entry and Exit (Duplicate File Copy)

subfiles.about: Application for Mexican Commercial Counselor Enrique Bravo to enter Japan to conduct an economic study mission.
subfiles.summary: Form DS-513 requesting three-month entry permit for Bravo to study Japanese economic conditions for Mexico.
subfiles.title: Form DS-513: Application for Permission to Enter Japan for Enrique Bravo
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff

subfiles.about: State Department forwards Mexican Commercial Counselor Enrique Bravo's entry application to the War Department.
subfiles.summary: Hibbard transmits Bravo's entry application to Captain Keough, requesting prompt referral to SCAP.
subfiles.title: Letter Transmitting Entry Application of Enrique Bravo to War Department

subfiles.about: State Department informs Mexican Ambassador that Enrique Bravo's application to enter Japan has been referred to military authorities.
subfiles.summary: Informs the Mexican Ambassador that Bravo's application has been forwarded to military authorities for consideration.
subfiles.title: Note Verbale to Mexican Ambassador Concerning Entry Application of Enrique Bravo

subfiles.about: Informs US diplomatic and consular officers of SCAP Circular 8 procedures for unrepresented foreign governments.
subfiles.summary: Transmits SCAP Circular 8, instructing that the Department will forward entry applications for governments lacking Tokyo representation.
subfiles.title: Circular Instruction to American Diplomatic and Consular Officers on Travel to Japan

subfiles.about: Official circular setting forth occupation control procedures for entry and exit of individuals, aircraft, and vessels.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Circular No. 8 text attached to consular instruction, detailing entry and exit rules, application channels, quarantine requirements, and military command duties.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 8 (Enclosure to Consular Circular Instruction)
